fees.notes: International student tuition: RM28,800 total. Source: https://www.uniten.edu.my/programme/diploma/diploma-in-business-studies/ (UNITEN official programme page, accessed 2026-09-18). Confirmed by UNITEN International Undergraduate Fee Structure (Dec 2024). per_year = total / 2yr nominal duration.

requirements.other_qualifications: Pass SPM/O-Level with minimum Grade C in any 3 subjects; or UEC with minimum 3 subjects Grade B6; or STPM with minimum Grade C (CGPA 2.00) in any subject; or STAM with minimum MAQBUL; or SKM Level 3 in a related field; international applicants require a High School Certificate with minimum 50% and Grade C in Mathematics and English.
